case_reviews.assessment: Confirmed JCM896 product qualifier and 1 g/584 ml arithmetic in the corrected frozen occurrence. The Difco catalogue paper is evidence of a TC product family, not approval to merge with generic yeast extract or an autoclaved stock.

Read JCM899 complete acidified stock: ammonium iron sulfate784 mg,25%HCl5 ml, nickel double salt395 mg and other listed salts. New C-P-JCM899 matches this recipe; all three receiving labels explicitly name899.

Inspected LS4D titanium-citrate nesting:37.5 ml20%TiCl3 is an input with sodium citrate and carbonate. Treating it as37.5 g/L dry TiCl3 or as the resulting chelate would be wrong; source concentration qualifier is retained.

JCM1389 specifies Acc8/JCM39386 culture in1388 followed by10000g10min centrifugation and anaerobic autoclaving. A conditioned biological supernatant is not an organism-taxon identity; preparation-specific disposition is warranted.

Directly compared JCM1355 modified mineral stock to151:1355 uses chloride salts including MnCl2 dihydrate and explicitly KOH adjustment. C-P-JCM1355 retains these differences and does not import the separate Fe-NTA mixture.

Live TOGO2596 prints basal NiCl3 hexahydrate while its separate trace stock prints NiCl2 hexahydrate. This is source-level ambiguity rather than normalization evidence; unresolved specific oxidations/stoichiometry is correct.

Both frozen occurrences are retained: DSMZ1702 and MediaDive3528. The Classic product page demonstrates a named artificial sea-salt line but does not identify which Tropic Marin line the short source label meant. Initial singular-occurrence wording was corrected.

NBRC837 ten-vitamin table was read directly and compared with197; constituent names and amounts support source-context equivalence, but a generic starred label should not be made a universal numbered-stock alias.

JCM437 explicitly names Sheffield typeA; Sigma C0626 primary sheet confirms a casein enzymatic digest but not equivalence of every supplier catalogue. Alias keeps typeA and UNMAPPED mixture status, so it does not promote a pure chemical.

The complete frozen MMJS context says Elemental sulfer3g and ChEBI33403 is elemental sulfur. Narrow spelling alias is reasonable; failed liveTOGO retrieval and inherited owner role/environment claims remain explicitly outside approval.

NBRC1136 has only the CHROMager trade-medium title and Kanto manufacturer, without constituents/catalogue. Its proprietary product boundary must remain; no agar or organism-taxon mapping can stand in for the medium.

ChEBI195690 formula and stereochemical structure identify L-ornithine hydrochloride; MediaDive3065 primary entry retains HCl. Free-baseCHEBI15729 in the frozen source is incompatible with exact salt identity and needs separate upstream correction.

JCM187 separates FeCl2 stock from its seven-salt trace-element solution. All11 explicit187 labels are retained. Proposed eight listed components including water faithfully exclude the separate Fe/HCl stock; inherited NCIT close mapping is not newly approved.

NBRC1140 directly prints Yeast extaract in GYA. Generic extract identity is supported, with no TC or autolysis qualifier. C alias is supported; the later combined B+C complete payload requires root review because B authors that integration.

Primary paper methods name Takeda cefsulodin and preserve reported5mg/ml. Neither the paper name nor ChEBI3507 specifies the existing sodium-salt hydrate. A salt-form hold is scientifically specific; do not silently rewrite the surprising unit.

Both NBRC1401 and TOGO2090 repeat Polypropylene glycol4000 (PEG4000). The propylene/ethylene repeat-unit contradiction cannot be resolved from molecular-weight grade or medium acronym; source correction is required.

Numbered source chain806→262→265→151 is consistent with the nested stock context. C-P-JCM151 preserves sulfate chemistry, MnSO4·xH2O and KOH rather than inventing exact hydrates or reading1000ml/L as the receiving-medium dose.

All40 frozen occurrences retain the explicit197 source reference. The primary197 ten-vitamin table matches the payload, including unspecified calcium pantothenate. Initial missing local ontology_mapping was fixed to FALLBACK_REGISTRY; dose anomalies such as185% remain unapproved upstream data.

TOGO2499 A5 includes raw CuSO2·5H2O; this cannot borrow CuSO4 from another BG11 version. Molybdate0.390g also differs from ATCC9570.039g. Conservative source-specific unresolved formulation is appropriate.

All three labels retain10% glucose solution and primary sources dispense volumes. The percent basis and solute form remain unresolved; no bare-glucose exact alias is proposed. This supports a source-stock context with a precise preparation gap.

JCM1406 specifies1M glucose solution20ml. Molarity identifies a solution concentration and does not identify the starting glucose hydrate or anomer. Potential linkage to115 requires source-preparation comparison, not a pure-solute alias.

JCM1412 specifies1.0M glucose20ml. Equivalent numeric spelling can be compared with114, but the solution object and unspecified solid form must survive. The no-change rationale identifies the missing common preparation scope.
NBRC1625 itself prints MnCl3·4H2O0.05mM. Familiar MSgg recipes are not a provider correction; replacingMnIII withMnII would assert unverified chemistry.
JCM1456 singular Trace vitamin is qualified by197 and denotes the full stock. SameC-P-JCM197 formulation is appropriate; singular wording is not grounds to select an individual vitamin.

Inspected full TOGO3181 JSON: table omits sodium molybdate whereas narrative includes40mg dihydrate; HCl vehicle is explicit. This discrepancy is retained and no generic Trace metals owner is asserted.

MediaDB context and PubChem entity do not establish the ferric-nitrate bottle hydration. Requirement to inspect the original Merlen1999 formulation/reagent source is concrete, and failed MediaDB access is not absence evidence.
JCM240 names BD-Difco yeast nitrogen base without any omission qualifier. It must not inherit the without-amino-acids or double-exclusion product formulation from other cases.

TOGO2811 distinguishes Oxoid liquid-BHI and Bioconnections agar branches; its two listed antibiotics support mixture identity. CurrentOxoidSR0096E alone cannot prove a historical catalogue/version or dose for this branch.

Read DSMZ1285 PDF directly: pH4–5 is adjusted with alginic acid. ChEBI17548 denotes the acid polymer and distinguishes alginate/sodium alginate; minimal new acid payload does not invent a grade or monomeric molecular property.

PrimaryJCM1375 explicitly references284 vitamins. Payload retains DL-calcium pantothenate9.5mg andB12 27.1mg, preventing a merge with197 or284mineral table. Shared B65/85 backlinks remain coordinator integration.

Both frozenJCM490 occurrences explicitly sayD--glucose, including nested solution input. ChEBI17634 supportsD identity, with no anomer/hydrate inference; source-access failure is acknowledged. A sharedD-glucose payload/backlink remains coordinator work.
TOGO2815 narrative explicitly identifies typeB as enzymatic casein digest. TypeB cannot be collapsed into typeA despite shared protein origin; a separate product specification remains necessary.

PCR-S11 Gaffron+Se table has15 solute entries pluswater, including problematic Cd(NO3).4H2O andVSO5.5H2O strings. Source-specific stock scope is correct; clarify that15 refers to solutes, and do not normalize those formulas without primary correction.

TOGO2578 and2179 identify catalogue255772 inside2% and10% solution preparations. The dry product and the two stocks are distinct objects. The Borrelia paper does not make ultrafiltration intrinsic to every TC yeastolate product.

TOGO2205 Modified Edwards medium supplies5% yeast dialysate but no dialysis protocol or cutoff. A preparation-specific unresolved identity is justified and does not transfer generic yeast-extract composition.
TOGO2231 explicitly defines4gNa2CO3 with1L deionizedwater and doses5ml; the frozen5G_PER_L is not carbonate mass. Whole-stock/solute distinction and source-unit correction are sound.
TOGO2790 narrative states2.5ml20%glucose per100mlM9, preserving both stock concentration and receiving batch scale. Percent basis is unspecified; w/v must not be borrowed fromB64/C140.

JCM1079 mineral table andpH3.6 were compared directly with C-P-JCM1079. Unspecified titrant does not prove explicit omission, so initialPARTIAL was changed toUNKNOWN under the schema definition. ExactEDTA salt form is not guessed.

All three occurrences are JCM18 Lactic Acid Bacteria Broth/MediaDive3640, notYM. That source attribution was corrected. Autolysate remains a distinct process preparation; source5g and4.9505g/L normalized values are not contradictory identities.

NBRC1356 list includes selenate and tungstate but lacks the alum added by857/936. The generic four-star label cannot select another formulation. Proposed follow-up must preserveNaOH adjustment and each original form.

Compared everyJCM439 stock amount withB52 NBRC1257/1321: iron2.1g equals2100mg, acid12.5ml, water987ml and allother constituents agree. C occurrence link is justified; root must independently review the combinedB-authored stock payload and new439alias.
JCM1435 explicitly adds5ml10%Oxoid yeast-extract solution. This is a stock rather than a dry-extract synonym; percent basis/product preparation remain material details.

evidence.explanation: Correction of ingredients[7].concentration (TC Yeastolate (BD-Difco)): source batch amount 1.0 g / (584 ml / 1000 ml per L) = 1.71233 g/L. The imported 40 ml denominator counts serum alone and is not the final volume.
